verdicts.decision_note: The client requests changing the Unit 1 bathroom door from a sliding door to a normal hinged door, directly altering the architectural door configuration.
The proposed hinged door has material collision risks in both swing directions, leaving the acceptable Unit 1 door configuration unresolved.
The client selects an inward-opening Unit 1 bathroom door and requests the sink-side clearance measurement as a concrete dimensional acceptance condition.
The client resolves the preceding door-orientation uncertainty by choosing the inward-opening configuration.
The dimensional check conflicts with the selected inward swing because the door hits the sink, while the proposed hall-opening alternative still requires client resolution.
First concrete dimensional failure: the inward-opening door collides with the sink and leaves only 82 cm of space.
